journal_lines: Blue-white flash in the deepslate. Stopped everything.
Vein ran to six. Took all of them.
Found it at the base of the cliff. Worth the whole trip.
A glint in the deepslate so cold the paw flinched.
Diamond does not glow. It refuses to. It only takes what light there is.
Older than ice. Harder than memory. Took it slowly.
The deepslate did not want to let it go. Convinced it.
A single stone the size of a tooth. Kept it close to the chest on the way home.
Two of them, side by side, like an old pair of eyes.
Found it where the light had not been in a thousand years. The light is back now, briefly.
Took the diamonds. Left a small mark on the wall where they had been.
